regions.region: title, abstract, and Introduction across both columns
regions.finding: The abstract states the paper-level selenohydroxylation claim; the Introduction summarizes cited prior halohydroxylation/selenolactonization work. These broad claims and literature examples were not converted into duplicate batch experiments.

Narrative screening results map to Table 1 entries 1-14 on page 2, including the aqueous-acetone no-reaction result and the 1.2-equiv PhSeCl override. The rows are represented independently and linked to page 1 only as supporting prose.

unresolved: Page 1 contains no complete table image; row-level values were checked against the page-2 original image.
Cited prior work was classified as context rather than this paper's reported batches.

regions.region: upper-left Table 1, reaction drawing, and footnotes
regions.finding: Fourteen independent solvent/time optimization rows were extracted. Entry 10 uses the footnoted 1.2 equiv PhSeCl; entry 11 preserves 0% NMR product yield and 91% recovered 1a as distinct outcome categories.

regions.region: lower-left Table 2, reaction drawing, and footnotes
regions.finding: Sixteen independent substrate-scope rows were extracted with shared quantities, times, isolated E-product yields, and the footnoted Z-chloride byproduct yields for entries 12-16.

The tosylation E-2o to E-4o (86%) and LiCl substitution E-4o to E-3o (60%) were represented as two successive experiments. The NOE drawing of Z-3o is structural comparison evidence, not an additional synthesis.
ORTEP Figure 1 establishes the reported regio-/stereochemical assignment of E-2b but is not a separate reaction experiment.

unresolved: Allene and selenium-product SMILES remain unverified; labels and original drawings are retained.
Scheme 1 on this page omits quantities, duration, atmosphere, workup, and purification.

regions.finding: Six independent 1l optimization rows were extracted with solvent ratio, temperature, time, NMR yield, and crude E-2l/Z-3l ratio. Table 3 entry 6 is the same 70 °C batch repeated as Table 4 entry 1 and was merged rather than duplicated.
Entries 2-5 were extracted independently; footnote b overrides the shared solvent ratio to 1/1 for entries 2 and 4. Entry 1 is linked to the merged Table 3 entry-6 record.
Three optically active selenohydroxylation experiments were extracted with starting/product ee, time, temperature, solvent ratio, and isolated yield.

regions.region: middle-left isotope/MS and mechanism discussion; lower-right Figure 2
regions.finding: The prose supports the three Scheme 3 isotope experiments and classifies Schemes 4/5 as proposed mechanisms. Figure 2 is an ORTEP assignment for S-E-2b, not an additional batch.

unresolved: Tables 3 and 4 omit participant amounts and workup details.
The mechanistic alternatives are explicitly not excluded by the authors and remain proposed, not verified.

regions.finding: ESI-MS/SIM-MS/MS plots for E-2h show the precursor near m/z 491 and daughter near m/z 473; this analytical evidence was linked to the existing Table 2 entry-8 experiment rather than made into a reaction record.
ESI-MS/SIM-MS/MS plots for E-2h* show the labeled precursor near m/z 493 and daughter near m/z 475; this was linked to the Scheme 3 isotope record.
General Procedure I begins the 1j preparation with starting alcohol identity and amount; the batch continues on page 5 and is represented once with cross-page evidence.

unresolved: Mass-spectral structure annotations were not converted to verified SMILES.
The 1j procedure is incomplete on page 4 alone and was reconciled with page 5.

regions.finding: Three H2-18O experiments (1h, 1c, 1e) were extracted with 1.5 equiv PhSeCl, 20/1 CH3CN/H2-18O, room-temperature times, displayed yields where present, and isotope incorporation. The page-5 scheme does not display a yield for E-2e*, so it remains missing.

regions.region: left column continuation of 4.1.1 and section 4.1.2
regions.finding: The cross-page General Procedure I batch for 1j and the reflux preparation of 1e were extracted with explicit quantities, operations, times, workup/purification where stated, product masses, and isolated yields.
Preparations of 1g and 1k were extracted; the preparation of 1p begins here and its product mass/yield continue on page 6, so one cross-page record was used.
Both generic R-group arrow sequences were classified as proposed mechanism/rationale records, not experimental batches.

unresolved: Abbreviated General Procedure I derivatives do not restate every temperature, workup, or purification detail.
E-2e* product yield is absent from the page-5 scheme and was not imported from uncovered later pages.

regions.finding: The product mass 2.3521 g and 47% isolated yield complete the cross-page preparation of 1p.
General Procedure II preparation of 1a and abbreviated preparations of S-1j and 1l were extracted. The 1l starting material's stated 95% purity/THF contamination was preserved.

regions.region: right column sections 4.2.4-4.2.5 and 4.2 comparison note
regions.finding: Preparations of 1o and R-1o were extracted. The explicitly separate General Procedure I comparison leading to only 60% ee R-1o from 99% ee alcohol was retained as its own partial experiment.

regions.region: right column section 4.3.1 and start of 4.3.2
regions.finding: The detailed General Procedure III batch for E-2a was merged into Table 2 entry 1 with quantities, workup, product mass, and yield. The opening quantities for E-2b were merged into Table 2 entry 2; its continuation beyond page 6 was not claimed as covered.

unresolved: The abbreviated General Procedure II preparations do not restate all stage temperatures and workups.
Sections 4.3.2 and later continue beyond page 6; only visible page-6 facts and the already extracted page-2 table outcomes were used.
Product ee is not explicitly quantified in the page-6 preparation paragraphs for S-1j or R-1o.
